entities.name: PMID:25100235
observations: In male WNIN/Ob rats fed retinyl palmitate diets for 20 weeks, vitamin A supplementation reduced obese-rat plasma HDL-C, increased hepatic SR-BI and lipase activity, and at 52/129 mg/kg lowered plasma LCAT activity and increased hepatic ABCA1; authors inferred improved RCT.

entities.name: Vitamin A modulates RCT
observations: In hypercholesterolemic obese WNIN/Ob rats, vitamin A (especially 52 or 129 mg/kg diet) altered RCT-related protein activities/expression and lowered HDL-C; the paper interpreted this as presumed RCT improvement, not direct measurement of whole-body cholesterol flux.
